offering_description.value: DexCom makes prescription and over-the-counter continuous glucose monitors for people managing diabetes or tracking their glucose for wellness. Wearable sensors transmit readings to a mobile app or dedicated receiver, and reporting tools let users share glucose trends with clinicians.

primary_products.value: Wearable glucose sensors; wireless transmitters; handheld receivers; glucose monitoring and reporting software

customer_segment.value: B2B: Pharmacies, medical supply distributors and healthcare systems; B2C: People with diabetes and consumers tracking glucose for wellness; B2G: Government healthcare systems, including U.S. Veterans Affairs facilities

end_markets.value: Diabetes care; consumer health and wellness

revenue_model.value: product sales: Glucose monitoring systems, replacement sensors and related hardware

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: Builds wearable monitors from sensor materials and electronics for patients and healthcare purchasing channels; software / platform: Turns sensor readings into alerts and reports for users and their care teams

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific and the Middle East

specialization.value: niche specialist: Prescription and over-the-counter glucose monitors with companion apps and reporting tools

distribution_channels.value: third-party retail: Retail and mail-order pharmacies; distributors / dealers: Durable medical equipment suppliers and international medical device distributors; online: Company web store for over-the-counter glucose monitors

regulatory_exposure.value: high: Glucose monitors require FDA marketing authorization in the U.S. and conformity under EU medical device rules.
